'''Stephen McCallum''' (also published as '''Steve McCallum''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2001 Chatswood tournament]] on 23 September 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Matthew Mohl's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2995">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ sydney-australia-23-09-2001], DeckTech (Matthew "Capsolo" Mohl, 25 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Stephen McCallum also played at [[October 2001 Sydney tournament (after 14 October)]] in October 2001 with [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|DS senate]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3081">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghook], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
